notes: This trace maps the portable C++ test to canonical IEEE 1516.1-2025 §11.4.1 and the pinned IEEE 1516.2-2025 standard MIM. It verifies the joined-federate Service Reporting switch false-to-true-to-false transition through HLAsetSwitches and the public getter, while a second joined federate's switch remains unchanged; the scenario's catalog mapping also directly relates this setter effect to the Lab's Clause 11.6 source-refinement row. It then observes one successful receive-order SendInteraction report at the second federate with the exact Table 5 argument values. This is a bounded §11.5 witness, not exhaustive evidence for every HLA service or RTI-invoked service; FDD initial values are separately checked for omitted and explicitly enabled inputs. This is development-profile traceability, not full MOM conformance.

requirements.statement: A joined federate may send individual declared parameters of the standard HLAsetSwitches interaction; HLAserviceReporting sets that joined federate's Service Reporting switch to the provided value, whose default is false.
